row: Being instrumental in changing the future animal-related causes and charities. Inspire people to volunteer in shelters, helping to find these animals a home and bring awareness to the community on how they can help and adopt these animals. We want students to have a healthy extracurricular activity where they can engage in exercising and interacting with dogs and cats. We also want to decrease the extreme levels of stress (and anxiety) college students go through.
